Youth engagement in demand-driven skilled training in sync with the market-based technology for improved employability of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

 About Tevta In 2002, Directorate of Technical Education and Manpower Training were merged to form the Directorate General of Technical Education & Manpower Training. The future of Pakistan is linked with our capability of imparting quality and market-oriented skills to our youth for employability through technical education & vocational training.
